copy.curiosityHook: With furious lenders bearing down and their pockets empty, the duo must rapidly scheme a way out of an escalating debt.
copy.description: After a swindler sells him a saloon and vanishes with the cash, Apache Chief Abahachi and his partner Ranger must quickly repay the Shoshones before pursuit escalates across the frontier.
copy.vibeSummary: Lighthearted, brisk, and easy to follow, playing out as a lively comic romp ideal for a quick laugh with friends.
copy.whyWatch: Directed by Michael Herbig, this fast German adventure sends frontier tropes into full-blown farce across an energetic 85 minutes.

allowedMaterial: Abahachi and Ranger's partnership as peacekeepers in the Wild West
Borrowing money from the Shoshone Indians for a saloon
Santa Maria's betrayal and theft of the funds
The Shoshones pursuing them for repayment
excludedMaterial: Eventual capture or fate of Santa Maria
